stem.text: A transverse water wave is moving along the surface of some water. This causes a ball to move vertically without moving horizontally as it floats upon the surface. At one instant, the ball is at the position shown.

stem.alt: Sketched sine-shaped wave with a circle labelled ball at its left end. A vertical double arrow is labelled 0.70 m. A horizontal double arrow is labelled 2.4 m, between a trough and an adjacent peak. An arrow labelled direction of wave travel points right. Printed note: NOT TO SCALE.

stem.text: The wave has a frequency of $0.20\,\text{Hz}$ and an amplitude of $0.70\,\text{m}$. The distance between a trough and an adjacent peak is $2.4\,\text{m}$.
What is the distance travelled by the ball in a time of $20\,\text{s}$?
